exception.justification: Justified: Location formatting inspects an already published audit outcome.

review.body: { match self . state { LocationState :: NotRead => formatter . write_str ("NotRead") , LocationState :: OverBound => formatter . write_str ("OverBound") , LocationState :: Row => formatter . debug_struct ("Row") . field ("relation" , & self . relation ()) . field ("key" , & LocationKey (self)) . finish_non_exhaustive () , } }
review.item_premise: The published audit location exposes only its fixed tag and already retained scalar key; inspection does not read or allocate store state.
